latin: Cum quaeritur a Platone an ad exemplar genitum an ingenitum factus sit mundus, nihil aliud quaeritur nisi an ad animales rationes, an ad ideas intellectuales.
translation: When it is asked of Plato whether the world was made according to a generated or an ungenerated exemplar, nothing else is being asked except whether it was made according to psychic (soul-level) rational principles, or according to intellectual Ideas.
